The company exhibits a large asset base and strong profit margins (65% gross, 23% operating) indicative of a stable, capital-intensive business model, which supports an investment-grade profile. However, the high total liabilities relative to operating income and a weak current ratio of 0.53 highlight significant leverage and short-term liquidity constraints, constraining the rating to the mid-to-lower investment grade tiers. 

DECISION: BBB
